Name: Growable Forage and Crop Bushes Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
This mod edits the crops and bushes of 6480's Growable Forage and Crop Bushes mod so that they are in Cometkins's style. This mod is also completely configurable, so you can toggle the retextured icons at your discretion. However, this mod has not been tested at length, so some errors may persist. Please report any errors that you find, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible.
